newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 20.

text.p: LONDON, Nov 20 - The following are among the events scheduled in the British Parliament on Wednesday.
- Questions to the Scottish Secretary at 1430 GMT.
- Debate on an opposition motion on the National Health Service from about 1530 GMT.
- Trade and Industry Committee hears from Gas and Electricity Consumers groups, and Chemical Industries Association. Hearing starts 1030 GMT, Chemical Industries Association evidence at 1110 GMT.
- Home Affairs Committee, inquiring into prison service, hears from its director, Richard Tilt. 1645 GMT.
- Environment Committee publishes report on water conservation and supply. Press conference 1200 GMT.
- Labour foreign affairs spokesman Robin Cook speaks at a Press Gallery lunch.
